suggestion.title: New jutsu icon
suggestion.rationale: New icon from the director-approved starter jutsu icon set.

New icon: a wooden log caught in a burst of smoke, with two glowing chakra arrows circling it, showing the instant swap that moves the user to another tile. It replaces the old small scene of a posing ninja, which was hard to read at small sizes.
